note: A certificate is stated with the execution rules: NLAlib.Ops.Specification.Accepts, NLAlib.Ops.Runs and NLAlib.Ops.Program.Certifies (now in Ops/Specification.lean) say that NLAlib.Ops.Reference.Execution derives an accepted outcome. The evaluator NLAlib.Ops.exec computes the same outcome; the theorems named _exec restate a statement with it, and proofs use them. Specification.Accepts takes the program, the interpretation and the tape (S.Accepts p I resources τ d x Q), where it took an optional outcome. NLAlib.Ops.Reference.Accepts is NLAlib.Ops.Specification.Accepts. NLAlib.Ops.Inputs.checked and NLAlib.Ops.Routine.Domain.checked_post state the rules form; a proof that needs the evaluator form of a certificate uses NLAlib.Ops.Algorithm.correct_exec in place of the field correct.
